+def extra_suffixes_workaround(upstream_mimetypes: Iterable[str]) -> Set[str]:
+    """Return extensions missing from the given MIME types and suffixes.
+
+    WORKAROUND: for https://bugreports.qt.io/browse/QTBUG-116905
+    Affected Qt versions > 6.2.2 (probably) < 6.7.0
+    """
+    if not (qtutils.version_check("6.2.3") and not qtutils.version_check("6.7.0")):
+        return set()
+
+    entries = set(upstream_mimetypes)
+    suffixes = {entry for entry in entries if entry.startswith(".")}
+    mimes = {entry for entry in entries if "/" in entry}
+    python_suffixes = set()
+    for mime in mimes:
+        if mime.endswith("/*"):
+            python_suffixes.update(
+                suffix
+                for suffix, mimetype in mimetypes.types_map.items()
+                if mimetype.startswith(mime[:-1])
+            )
+        else:
+            python_suffixes.update(mimetypes.guess_all_extensions(mime))
+    return {suffix for suffix in python_suffixes if suffix.startswith(".")} - suffixes
+
